title: Rat learning experiments as evidence for morphic resonance
place_text: London, New York, San Francisco, Melbourne, Beijing

tellings.quote: now there's actual evidence from a long series of experience with rats that that actually happens

plain: The scientist Rupert Sheldrake says a long series of rat experiments backs up his idea of morphic resonance: once some members of a species learn something, others of that species elsewhere learn it more easily. The rats were in places such as London, New York, San Francisco, Melbourne and Beijing. Sheldrake summarises the experiments without naming a source and calls them "actual evidence" that this "actually happens," which would mean learning passes between animals with no ordinary contact.
